data.name: Mulhim
data.gender_notes: Mulhim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is well-versed in knowledge and wisdom, a sage. The name Mulhim carries the meaning “Wise, Knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mulhim usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, and the understanding of the divine.
data.etymology: Mulhim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Knowledgeable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mulhim total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: ملهم
in_arabic.meaning: اسم من ملهم، من الأسماء التي توحي بالالهام و الارشاد
in_arabic.long_meaning: ملهم هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: المُلهم، الذي يلهمه الله تعالى للحق، ويعطيه الإلهام. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة: ﴿فَأَلهمها فُؤادُها﴾، أي ألهمها قلبها. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي توحي بالالهام و الارشاد، و هو من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: ملہم
in_urdu.meaning: ملہم، ایک ایسا نام جو الہام اور رہنمائی کا احساس دلاتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ملہم ایک علم کا نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جسے اللہ تعالیٰ الہام کرتا ہے یا صحیح راستے پر چلنے کی رہنمائی کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں جہاں اردو بولی جاتی ہے۔ اس کا تعلق قرآن کی سورة البقرة سے بھی ہے جہاں الہام کے تصور پر بحث کی گئی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुलहिम
in_hindi.meaning: मुलहिम, एक ऐसा नाम जो ईश्वरीय प्रेरणा और मार्गदर्शन का प्रतीक है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुलहिम एक सुंदर नाम है जिसका अर्थ है 'प्रेरित' या 'ईश्वरीय मार्गदर्शन प्राप्त करना'। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत पसंद किया जाता है क्योंकि यह आध्यात्मिक और धार्मिक महत्व रखता है। मुलहिम नाम का व्यक्ति प्रेरित और ईश्वर की कृपा से युक्त माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: ملهم
in_pashto.meaning: ملهم، داسې نوم چې الهام او لارښوونې مفهوم ورکوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: ملهم یو نوم دی چې د الهام او لارښوونې معنا لري. دا نوم د افغانستان او پاکستان د پښتنو په کلتور کې ډیر اهمیت لري. ملهم هغه څوک دی چې الله تعالی ورته الهام کوي او یا یې د حق لارې ته لارښوونه کوي. دا نوم د پښتو ژبې او اسلامی ثقافت سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Mulhim
in_english.meaning: Inspiring, guiding, or one who receives divine inspiration
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mulhim originates from Arabic roots and signifies 'inspiring' or 'one who receives divine inspiration.' It is derived from the Arabic term 'mulhim,' which means 'inspiring' or 'guiding.' This name holds significant spiritual connotations in Islamic tradition, suggesting a person who is guided or inspired by Allah. Historically, the concept of ilham (inspiration) is discussed in the Quran, emphasizing guidance from Allah. The name Mulhim is cherished across various Muslim cultures for its profound religious and spiritual implications.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mulhim holds great significance in Islamic culture as it has been bestowed upon an individual who is highly educated and knowledgeable. It is a title of respect and admiration, reflecting the high value placed on knowledge and wisdom in Islamic society. The intellectual pursuit and the acquisition of knowledge are considered noble pursuits, and one who possesses this knowledge is held in high regard.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mulhim implies an inner wisdom and understanding that extends beyond mere academic learning. It suggests a deep connection with God and a commitment to seek truth and knowledge for the purpose of serving Him and bettering oneself and the community. The pursuit of wisdom and knowledge is seen as a means of drawing closer to God and increasing one's understanding of His divine laws and teachings. Therefore, the name Mulhim can be seen as a representation of an enlightened and wise soul, one who has delved deep into the spiritual dimensions of knowledge and emerged with a greater understanding of the world around them and the divine guidance from the Almighty.
